The '''''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer''', also known as '''Advanced Star Destroyer''',<ref name="SWL20" /> was the designation given to the [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']], which was built during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Imperious_side.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The ''Imperious'', partially obscured by scaffolding.]]
{{Quote|It's an impressive ship, Lieutenant Dubrok. A tribute to Mon Calamari engineering.|[[Gial Gahan]] to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Strom Dubrok]]|<ref name="SWL20" />}}
The ''Imperious''-class was designed to make use of several especially large thrusters and sported a 'tailfin' similar to those of the Star Destroyers of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The class' command bridge was very similar in design to those of most [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]], while spaced in pairs on its sloped superstructure were several towers of unknown purpose.<ref name="SWL20" /> Compared to the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class]], the ''Imperious''-class was larger and more powerful, as well as more efficient in the regulation of its power. It had better shielding to the point that it could take on the full firepower of the [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]] before the shields began to falter, armor, and weapons (which included [[Gravity mine/Legends|gravity mines]]) allowing it to outgun any ship within the Imperial Fleet of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. In addition, the ''Imperious''-class could be operated by a smaller crew. Generally, it was to the ''Pellaeon''-class what the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] was to the preceding [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class]].<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
[[File:Imperious_top_down.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The ''Alliance'']]
The ''Imperious''-class started life as the answer to [[Darth Krayt]]'s demand for a new class of warship that could overpower any other warship type used by the enemies of the Empire. Proposed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rulf Yage]], head of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], the project was turned over to the engineers and designers of the [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]], who were tasked with creating a new warship that was an overall improvement of the successful ''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer. As such, the ''Imperious''-class was ironically a Mon Calamari design, despite being built for the Empire.<ref name="LECG" />

Soon enough, a [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|prototype]] was constructed at the Mon Calamari Shipyards, but in [[137 ABY]], before it could embark on its maiden voyage, it was used as bait for [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] and his [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|remnant forces]].<ref name="SWL20" /> Imperial Admiral [[Dru Valan]] of the [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]] [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|attempted to trap]] Stazi and his [[Core Fleet|fleet]], but Stazi's fleet was able to escape with the ''Imperious''.<ref name="SWL21" />

Masters [[Sigel Dare]] and [[Treis Sinde]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] [[Imperial Knight]]s had planted explosives on the ship, meant to activate once the weapons-systems came online, long before the ship was hijacked by the Alliance. When Admiral Stazi became aware of the danger, the explosives were removed, and the two governments began discussing an alliance again. The ship was rechristened the ''Alliance'' by Stazi to symbolize the one thing the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] feared the most.<ref name="SWL22" />

Despite the loss of the prototype, the damage to the shipyards that built it, as well as their subsequent shutdown following the Sith's extermination of the Mon Calamari, Krayt ordered the construction of more ''Imperious''-class vessels before his demise.<ref name="LECG" />

At least one other ''Imperious''-class vessel was fielded. The ''[[Darklight]]'' was sent to [[Bombing of Falleen|subjugate]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] in [[138 ABY]]. The ship was lost when it was infiltrated and sabotaged by [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Wolf Sazen]].<ref name="SWLW2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref>
